specialInstructions: Keyboard product names are the board model, NOT the switch variant. 'Keychron Q1 Pro with Gateron Browns' and 'Keychron Q1 Pro with Cherry Reds' are the SAME product (Keychron Q1 Pro). The switch type is context, not a product identifier.
Layout sizes: Full-size = ~104 keys, TKL (tenkeyless) = ~87 keys, 75% = ~84 keys, 65% = ~68 keys, 60% = ~61 keys. These describe the layout, not different products of the same model.
Distinguish between product generations: K70 Core, K70 RGB Pro, K70 RGB TKL are different products, not variants of the same.
Keycap sets mentioned alongside a keyboard (e.g. 'I put GMK Olivia on my Q1') are accessories, not product references — do not extract them as separate products.
Sound descriptions (thock, clack, hollow) are evaluations of the 'sound' feature. Mods (foam, tape, lube) are context for those evaluations.
The term 'endgame' in keyboard communities means 'final/ultimate keyboard' — it's a strong personal_verdict indicator.

useCases.label: programming
useCases.description: Compact layouts, programmable layers, QMK/VIA, split/ergonomic, travel-friendly

useCases.label: office

features.label: switches
features.description: Switch type, brand, actuation force, travel distance, smoothness, and factory lube quality
features.shortDescription: The switch mechanism itself, not the resulting typing feel (that's 'typing feel')

issues.label: switch chatter
issues.description: Key registers multiple presses from a single keystroke, switch bouncing issue

issues.label: key wobble
issues.description: Excessive keycap wobble or loose stems on switches

features.label: typing feel
features.description: Overall keystroke experience — tactility, bottoming out, key travel, and comfort during extended typing
features.shortDescription: The resulting feel of typing, not the switch specs (that's 'switches')

features.label: keycaps
features.description: Keycap material (ABS, PBT, double-shot), texture, legends, profile (Cherry, OEM, SA), and shine resistance

issues.label: keycap shine
issues.description: Keycaps developing shiny spots from use, typically ABS plastic

features.label: build quality
features.description: Chassis materials (aluminum, plastic), flex, weight, overall fit and finish, durability
features.shortDescription: Chassis and construction, not the switches or keycaps

issues.label: PCB flex
issues.description: Circuit board flexes visibly when typing, causing inconsistent key feel across the board

features.label: sound
features.description: Acoustic profile — thock, clack, ping, hollowness, foam dampening, tape mod results
features.shortDescription: How the keyboard sounds, not the switch mechanism (that's 'switches')

issues.label: ping/reverb
issues.description: Metallic ping, spring reverb, or hollow sound when typing

features.label: stabilizers
features.description: Stabilizer rattle, mushiness, tuning, lubing, and performance on larger keys (spacebar, shift, enter)

issues.label: stabilizer rattle
issues.description: Rattle, mushiness, or inconsistency from stabilizers on spacebar, shift, or enter keys

issues.label: spacebar rattle
issues.description: Specific spacebar stabilizer noise — the most commonly reported stabilizer issue

features.label: wireless
features.description: Wireless connectivity — Bluetooth reliability, 2.4GHz dongle, multi-device switching, range
features.shortDescription: Wireless connection quality, not battery life (that's 'battery life')

issues.label: bluetooth latency
issues.description: Noticeable input delay when using Bluetooth connection

issues.label: wireless dropouts
issues.description: Wireless connection intermittently drops, causing missed keystrokes

features.label: battery life
features.description: Battery longevity, charging method, USB-C charging, battery type, power management

issues.label: battery drain
issues.description: Battery drains faster than expected, especially with RGB enabled

features.label: software
features.description: Companion software, QMK/VIA support, macro programming, RGB customization, firmware updates

issues.label: software bugs
issues.description: Companion software crashes, fails to save profiles, or has configuration issues

features.label: layout
features.description: Physical layout — full-size, TKL, 75%, 65%, 60%, split — and key arrangement preferences

features.label: hot-swap
features.description: Hot-swap socket availability, compatibility with different switches, 3-pin vs 5-pin support

features.label: RGB
features.description: RGB lighting brightness, per-key control, effects, south-facing LEDs, light bleed through keycaps

issues.label: LED failure
issues.description: Individual LEDs dying, flickering, or showing wrong colors

features.label: ergonomics
features.description: Typing angle, wrist rest, split design, tenting, and overall ergonomic comfort

features.label: latency
features.description: Input latency, polling rate, rapid trigger, analog input, wired vs wireless latency
